description: This is a three-tiered staircase tower with a central concrete structure and wooden platforms at each level. The staircase itself is a spiral design made of wood with metal railings. The tower is situated on a square wooden platform, which is then placed on a larger square floor. The overall structure is minimalist and functional, likely serving as an access point or viewing platform. The concrete has a rough texture, while the wood provides a warmer contrast. The design is simple and geometric, with clean lines.
